components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default dense action; near-black fill for CRUD and navigation commitments.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Raleway, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; color: #fafafa; background-color: #171717; border: none; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: rgb(23 23 23 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #171717, 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Brand / Cashback Button
components.description: Loyalty and brand-forward CTAs; amber field with black label text.
components.css: .ds-btn-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Raleway, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #000000; background-color: #ffb900; border: none; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-brand:hover { background-color: rgb(255 185 0 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-brand:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #171717; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions with hairline border and transparent fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Raleway, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #171717; background-color: transparent; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: #f5f5f5; color: #171717; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #171717; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field matching shadcn Input; full width in forms.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: Raleway, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25; color: #171717; background-color: transparent; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #171717; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Contained surface for KPIs, lists, and dense dashboard fragments.
components.css: .ds-card { box-sizing: border-box; padding: 24px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #171717; border: 1px solid #e5e5e5; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px 0; font-family: Raleway, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #737373; }

components.name: Dashboard Section
components.description: Bordered module shell with uppercase micro-label between stats and tables.
components.css: .ds-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; width: 100%; padding: 16px 12px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgb(23 23 23 / 0.2); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-section-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 32px; } .ds-section-title { font-family: Raleway, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; color: #171717; } .ds-section-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }

components.name: Sidebar Menu Item
components.description: Icon + label row at 16px rail; hover uses quiet gray pill.

components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Raleway, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #3f3f46; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background-color: #f4f4f5; color: #18181b; } .ds-nav-icon { flex-shrink: 0; color: currentColor; }

narrative.overview: RecompraCRM looks like a tool the shop owner trusts beside the cash drawer: legible numbers first, obvious actions second, warm utility instead of startup gloss. The base is a neutral light shell (soft white canvas, near-black type) so dense commerce data, RFM grids, and WhatsApp campaign stats stay readable for hours. Loyalty and promotional energy concentrate in a single amber used for cashback and brand moments rather than painting whole screens.
keyCharacteristics: Raleway-forward typography with bold weight contrast for page titles and semibold for card titles.
shadcn-style radii: 0.5rem base with derived sm/md steps; cards often step up to rounded-xl (12px).
Primary UI ink is neutral near-black on white; charts pull from chart-* hues in CSS, plus domain blues/ambers in some commerce screens.
Navigation is a persistent sidebar (≈16rem, sheet on mobile) with grouped Portuguese labels matching module IA.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber appears where money returned to the customer or brand promise is the story, not for general navigation or table chrome.

rules.name: The No Neon Chroma Rule
rules.body: Charts use balanced saturation from predefined chart-* slots; do not introduce neon greens, purple gradients on data backgrounds, or decorative gradients that compete with KPI readability.

rules.name: The Section Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Uppercase is reserved for section headers and compact module labels, not for long sentences or table column titles.

rules.name: The Flat Canvas Rule
rules.body: The page background stays flat; elevation cues belong to interactive objects, not full-bleed section backgrounds.

dos: Do keep body copy and numeric tables on near-black ink and white/loft-gray surfaces for daylight readability at the counter.
Do use loyalty-amber sparingly for cashback, gift, and brand-forward CTAs.
Do respect the sidebar + SectionWrapper rhythm when adding modules.
Do use chart-1…chart-5 for multi-series visuals before introducing new hex colors.
Do pair bold weight jumps (800/700 titles vs 400 body) for hierarchy.
donts: Don't cover large dashboard areas in saturated amber or chart colors.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism panels, or neon dual-tone skins that read as generic AI-SaaS marketing.
Don't apply colored left/right border stripes thicker than 1px as the primary way to mark list rows.
Don't shrink label text below 0.75rem for critical operational labels without testing touch targets on tablet POS flows.
Don't mute destructive actions visually: keep destructive contrast and wording explicit for money movement and campaign sends.
